caseStudiesIndex.title: Needs-Based Finance Case Studies
caseStudiesIndex.intro: Explore representative examples of how climate finance needs can be assessed, prioritized, and translated into practical pathways for action.
caseStudiesIndex.currentSupportTitle: Selected needs-based finance examples currently under UNFCCC support
caseStudiesIndex.currentSupportIntro: These examples are currently being supported through the UNFCCC needs-based finance work and are open for engagement by funders, climate funds, accredited entities, delivery partners and other relevant institutions.
caseStudiesIndex.formerSupportTitle: Additional needs-based finance examples open for support
caseStudiesIndex.formerSupportIntro: These examples were previously supported through UNFCCC needs-based finance work. They are no longer under active UNFCCC support but remain open for engagement by funders, partners and relevant institutions where country ownership and partner interest continue.
